sentence: This project compares transcatheter left atrial appendage occlusion devices with oral anticoagulants for people living with dementia and atrial fibrillation.
This project studies the causes of von Willebrand disease and sickle cell disease, including the role of lipoproteins and oxidized phospholipids.
This project studies how the gut microbiome interacts with hormone therapy and estrogens in menopause symptoms and cardiovascular disease.
This project studies how gene mutations in B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia affect how the leukemia develops and how patients respond to treatment.
This project tries to stop cancer metastasis by blocking curvature-induced kinase activation, which helps cancer cells survive.
This project tests whether genes found in inherited dilated cardiomyopathy could be drug targets, using human in vitro models and a mouse model.
This project builds a sensor driven smart faucet that delivers water at set temperature and force for people with Alzheimer's disease and dementia.
This project tests an intervention that offers alcohol-free social activities to reduce heavy episodic drinking among members of a fraternity or sorority.
This project tests whether genome editing treatments given under the retina are safe by checking nonhuman primate eyes for toxicity.
This project studies how changes in genes that repair damaged DNA lead to lethal prostate cancer and looks for combination treatments.
This project tests thousands of variants of a myosin gene in cardiomyocytes to find which ones cause hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.
This project moves laboratory findings into early phase clinical trials and supports studies of biomarkers and resistant tumor specimens in neuroblastoma.
This project provides data management, statistical support and technology tools for research projects and protects the collected data with cybersecurity measures.
This project builds a smartphone app that tracks whole-body movement from phone video to judge how severe Parkinson's disease movement symptoms are.
This project designs studies of targeted therapies for spondyloarthritis, a form of childhood arthritis.
This project improves computer simulation methods to study how enzymes are built and how they carry out chemical reactions.
This project offers tools that combine DNA and RNA sequencing data with mass spectrometry data to identify proteins involved in cancer.
This project develops a gene-editing therapy delivered before birth in lipid nanoparticles for a neurodevelopmental disorder linked to an overactive gene.
This project visualizes how bacteria and archaea fold their DNA into shapes that help CRISPR adapt to phages.
